pages.text: Tomorrow is the alley party. They need to bake lots and lots of bread.
Mom brought out the big dough tub. "I want to try kneading too." Coco rolled up their sleeves.
Mr. Pig came into the shop. "Kneading takes strength! Let me help."
He lifted the dough high. It stretched and stretched.
He slammed the dough down. Thump, thump! Flour rose in a cloud.
Achoo! He let out a great big sneeze.
The flour cloud settled. Mr. Pig was as white as a snowman.
Coco kneaded their own dough gently. Not a bit of flour flew into the air.
Coco's dough became a smooth ball. Into the oven it went.
Coco's bread came out golden brown. White Mr. Pig was the first to take a piece. "My help made it turn out well!"
